usedFor: Teamleader Focus holds your deals, and Slack announces wins when “Deal Accepted” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Deal Accepted” in Teamleader Focus, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: An accepted deal reaches a Slack channel, so the team can plan delivery straight away.

watchOut: The catalog describes “Deal Accepted” as firing when a deal is updated, so check it does not announce unrelated edits.
